description_excerpt: Job Description Strong coordination & digital skill for the QMS processes, including: • Support in exploring & applying AI tools/AI agent solutions to streamline repetitive tasks & optimize workflows. • Support to update process documentation on HcP Process Compass, ensuring consistency & compliance with Bosch central directives. • Support to coordinate & follow up Quality method topics (internal & external audit, QMS KPI updates,…). • Support the quality management team in various projects and initiatives related to digital and non-digital QMS e.g Preventive Quality, Gap Analysis,…
